## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused change.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated tests where appropriate
- [ ] Ran relevant local checks (list commands and results)
- [ ] Updated documentation where behavior or workflow changed

## Security and scope

- [ ] This pull request contains no credentials, tokens, private task content, raw environment dumps, or unneeded sensitive data.
- [ ] I have not used this template to disclose a suspected vulnerability; those follow the private route in `SECURITY.md`.

## Release notes (when preparing a release or editing its notes)

- [ ] Followed [the reader-facing template and editorial rubric](../docs/release-notes.md), keeping engineering evidence separate.
- [ ] A reviewer other than the notes author completed `.github/release-notes/<version>.json` for the final text.
- [ ] Ran `npm run release:notes` before tagging. No approval is needed for unrelated development or changes only under Unreleased.

## Notes

List any tradeoffs, follow-up work, or review context. Review occurs as maintainer capacity allows; this repository has no guaranteed review timeline.
